## v0.8.4 — Split level

**Level** is a two-axis spirit level from the accelerometer. Roll is a horizontal bar; pitch is a vertical bar on the right. Both axes within ±1° show `LEVEL`.

Voice recordings are 32 kHz mono PCM. The mic uses analog gain, and each chunk is written only after the recorder has finished filling it.

Status and hint lines use the largest text size that still fits the screen.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.4** (Companion versionCode 6). Companion behavior is unchanged.

`cardputer_adv_firmware-0.8.4.bin` · `CardputerCompanion-0.8.4.apk`
